note: Two campgrounds about 2 km apart near Patterson: Campground 1 in woods above the St. Francis River, and Campground 2 along Big Creek, whose east-side sites (145-153, 159-160) sit on the wooded bank. Campground 2 stays open in winter with water only at the visitor center spigot. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT riverfront kept, on Campground 2 only: Big Creek at Campground 2 is ~35-40 m of open water on leaf-off Esri imagery (over the ~30 m line, so riverfront rather than creekside).
